verdict.rationale: Hightouch's documented MCP server explicitly lets an AI assistant create audiences, manage syncs, generate content, and analyze campaign performance in natural language (hightouch-docs-10, -11, -55, -56), and a separate REST API exposes syncs/models/sources/destinations with API-key auth for programmatic control (hightouch-docs-13, -33, -50). This covers query + create + activate end-to-end without requiring the dashboard, though the docs elsewhere frame Customer Studio's no-code UI as the default flow, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence of an actual end-to-end MCP run. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of full agent-only workflow, explicit API examples for querying/reading warehouse data directly (vs. just syncing/activating), and clarity that audience creation via MCP fully bypasses any UI-configured schema step.
